sponsored.t: Requires landlords in the city of New York to provide fire extinguishers in certain dwellings
sponsored.sum: Requires landlords of non-owner occupied, one-six family dwellings in the city of New York to provide fire extinguishers in all rented apartments; authorizes the promulgation of standards related thereto.

sponsored.t: Prohibits local laws from requiring certain storefront security gates or grilles comply with certain conditions
sponsored.sum: Prohibits local laws from requiring certain storefront security gates or grilles comply with certain conditions; extends the provisions concerning existing storefront security gates or grilles.

sponsored.t: Renames the 8th Avenue subway station to the 8th Avenue - Brooklyn Chinatown station
sponsored.sum: Renames the 8th Avenue subway station to the 8th Avenue - Brooklyn Chinatown station.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of taxation and finance to help entities to elect to participate in the federal tax credit for elementary and secondary scholarships
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of taxation and finance to help entities to elect to participate in the federal tax credit for elementary and secondary scholarships known as the Educational Choice for Children Act of 2025.

sponsored.t: Relates to sentences of imprisonment for offenses committed while using public transportation
sponsored.sum: Imposes certain sentences of imprisonment for offenses committed while using public transportation; creates the offense of reckless endangerment on public transportation as a class A-I felony.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the construction of certain energy storage systems within five hundred feet of a school or dwelling in N.Y. City
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the construction or maintenance of energy storage systems capable of storing more than twenty kilowatt hours within five hundred feet of a school or dwelling in a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Directs the superintendent of financial services to conduct a study examining the feasibility of 40- and 50-year mortgages in the state of New York
sponsored.sum: Directs the superintendent of financial services to conduct a study examining the feasibility of 40- and 50-year mortgages in the state of New York; requires such superintendent to submit a report of findings.

sponsored.t: Relates to the placement of homeless shelters
sponsored.sum: Requires that no homeless shelter shall be located within five hundred feet of a transit facility or within a building that has a rent-controlled or rent-stabilized dwelling unit.

sponsored.t: Creates certain age and other requirements for the New York naval militia and the New York guard
sponsored.sum: Establishes a maximum age of seventy-two for service and a maximum enlistment or commission age of fifty for the New York naval militia and the New York guard; creates uniform and training requirements for the New York guard.

sponsored.t: Relates to the identification of Asian Lunar New Year and the declaration of such day as a public holiday
sponsored.sum: Directs the secretary of the senate and the clerk of the assembly to identify the date of Asian Lunar New Year; declares such day as a public holiday each year.

sponsored.t: Relates to withholding the governor and lieutenant governor's salaries until the legislative passage of the budget occurs
sponsored.sum: Relates to withholding the governor and lieutenant governor's salaries until the legislative passage of the budget occurs.

sponsored.t: Directs the New York state department of transportation and the New York city department of transportation to conduct a study on parking availability
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York state department of transportation and the New York city department of transportation to conduct a study on parking availability along the portion of 8th Avenue between 39th street and 73rd street in the borough of Brooklyn in the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of civil service to conduct a study on Asian American and Pacific Islander (AAPI) employment in the public sector workforce
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of civil service to conduct a study on Asian American and Pacific Islander (AAPI) employment in the public sector workforce including the current levels of employment and how to increase participation in the state and local public sector workforce.

sponsored.t: Requires the inspection of buildings where bicycles with electric assist are repaired, sold, rented, or stored for repair, sale, or rental
sponsored.sum: Requires the periodic inspection of commercial buildings where bicycles with electric assist are repaired, sold, rented, or stored for repair, sale, or rental; requires such inspection quarterly; requires the state fire prevention and building code council to establish a fee for such inspection; requires the inspection of such buildings following a fire-related emergency or other fire-related incident.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing penalties for public urination or defecation
sponsored.sum: Increases penalties for public urination or defecation to $500 for any violation.

sponsored.t: Requires fire insurance for any building where bicycles with electric assist are repaired, sold, rented, or stored for repair, sale or rental
sponsored.sum: Requires fire insurance for any building where bicycles with electric assist are repaired, sold, rented, or stored for repair, sale or rental; requires insurance coverage of at least one million dollars and an additional one hundred thousand dollars per tenant if tenants reside in such building.

sponsored.t: Establishes the organized militia as public employees working group
sponsored.sum: Establishes the organized militia as public employees working group to examine the potential costs and benefits of designating members of the New York state organized militia as public employees.

sponsored.t: Relates to the SUNY Maritime admissions program
sponsored.sum: Relates to the SUNY Maritime admissions program increasing the number of positions reserved for nomination by the governor and members of the legislature and scholarship under the SUNY Maritime admissions program.

sponsored.t: Relates to the recruitment incentive and retention program for members of the New York state organized militia; repealer
sponsored.sum: Includes New York guard members to the recruitment incentive and retention program for members of the New York state organized militia; permits tuition benefits for post-graduate study.

sponsored.t: Relates to waiving application fees for individuals who certify they are unemployed
sponsored.sum: Waives application fees for individuals who certify to the state civil service department that they are unemployed; removes provisions requiring an individual also be primarily responsible for the support of a household or receiving public assistance.

sponsored.t: Enacts "Barreto's law"
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Barreto's law" which establishes the crime of vehicular manslaughter in the third degree.

sponsored.t: Establishes a day of commemoration known as "October 7th Remembrance Day"
sponsored.sum: Establishes a day of commemoration known as "October 7th Remembrance Day".

sponsored.t: Allows the state and city university of New York system to offer college credits to prospective students
sponsored.sum: Allows the state and city university of New York system to offer college credits to prospective students based on such prospective student's performance on the regents examinations.

sponsored.t: Relates to delaying the implementation of class size reduction plans and including additional exemptions to class size targets
sponsored.sum: Relates to delaying the implementation of class size reduction plans and including additional exemptions to class size targets; provides such plans shall begin in September 2031 and be achieved by September 2036; adds gifted and talented schools and programs, screened admissions schools and programs, portfolio and specialized high schools and advanced placement classes; requires parents at each respective school be included on any discussions regarding class size exemptions.

sponsored.t: Relates to defense and indemnification of public officers and employees; repealer
sponsored.sum: Requires defense and indemnification of public officers and employees in certain cities; repeals provisions relating to the right of security against unreasonable search and seizure.

sponsored.t: Relates to final judgments on a petition
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Requires that in cases concerning dwellings with two units or less, petitions that go to trial be resolved in six months or less upon issue being joined; provides that in cases concerning dwellings with three or four units, the court shall render a final judgment on a petition no later than twelve months from the date upon which the issue is enjoined.

sponsored.t: Requires the commissioner of education mandate schools donate unused food to local food banks
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of education mandate schools donate unused food to local food banks and establish policies and procedures to effectuate such program.

sponsored.t: Relates to military service qualifying for military service credit
sponsored.sum: Exempts certain military service credit from being included in calculations of up to three years of military service credit for a public retirement system of the state.

sponsored.t: Designates the month of May as Elder Appreciation Month
sponsored.sum: Designates the month of May as "Elder Appreciation Month".
